Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ADDITIONAL SHEET 2, movement and acrobatics, by editing the attached approved 8x8 Rattus norvegicus sprite sheet.
LOCK THE DESIGN: exact same adult female wrestler, gray rat mask and snout, green pointed wizard hat, auburn hair, black/gold ring top and trunks, gold knee pads, black/gold boots and navy/gold cape. Same figure proportions, compact coarse pixel style and palette. Change only poses.

Row2: bent-knee lateral shuffle, side-to-side weight transfer, sidestep and torso turn with an over-shoulder look.
Row3: forward floor roll, crouch, tuck, complete rotation with inverted middle frames, brace and rise.
